examples.chinese: 現在這條街上沒有車。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài zhè tiáo jiē shàng méiyǒu chē.
examples.english: There are no cars on this street now.

examples.chinese: 從我家去捷運站，過一條街就到了，交通很方便。
examples.pinyin: Cóng wǒ jiā qù jiéyùn zhàn, guò yì tiáo jiē jiù dào le, jiāotōng hěn fāngbiàn.
examples.english: From my home to the MRT station, cross one street and you're there; the transportation is very convenient.

examples.chinese: 我常常跟朋友一起去逛街。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ chángcháng gēn péngyǒu yìqǐ qù guàngjiē.
examples.english: I often go shopping with friends.

examples.chinese: 這整條街都是賣體育用品的店，只要來這裡就能買到想要的運動鞋。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhěng tiáo jiē dōu shì mài tǐyù yòngpǐn de diàn, zhǐyào lái zhèlǐ jiù néng mǎi dào xiǎng yào de yùndòng xié.
examples.english: This entire street is full of stores selling sports supplies; as long as you come here, you can buy the athletic shoes you want.

examples.chinese: 這次的水災不僅淹了整條街，好幾家工廠也因為淹水沒辦法生產，真是太糟了！
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de shuǐzāi bùjǐn yān le zhěng tiáo jiē, hǎo jǐ jiā gōngchǎng yě yīnwèi yānshuǐ méi bànfǎ shēngchǎn, zhēn shì tài zāo le!
examples.english: This flooding not only flooded the entire street, but several factories also couldn't produce because of the flooding—it's really too bad!

examples.chinese: 我和朋友昨天去河邊露營， 我們試著在河裡抓魚，沒想到真的抓到了五條魚。金先生親眼見過警察在街上抓小偷，一個跑來跑去，一個追來追去，他覺得太刺激了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé péngyǒu zuótiān qù hébiān lùyíng, wǒmen shìzhe zài hé lǐ zhuā yú, méi xiǎngdào zhēn de zhuā dào le wǔ tiáo yú. Jīn xiānsheng qīnyǎn jiàn guò jǐngchá zài jiē shàng zhuā xiǎotōu, yī ge pǎo lái pǎo qù, yī ge zhuī lái zhuī qù, tā juéde tài cìjī le.
examples.english: My friend and I went camping by the river yesterday; we tried to catch fish in the river, and unexpectedly, we really caught five fish. Mr. Jin has seen with his own eyes the police catching a thief on the street—one running back and forth, the other chasing back and forth—he thought it was too exciting.

examples.chinese: 我跟弟弟是雙胞胎，很多人都以為我是他，這樣的誤會我早就習慣了。A:何小姐只是我的鄰居，不是我的女朋友，大家都誤會了。 B:你對她很體貼，不但常送她上班，還常陪她逛街，大家對你們有誤會也是正常的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn dìdi shì shuāngbāotāi, hěn duō rén dōu yǐwéi wǒ shì tā, zhèyàng de wùhuì wǒ zǎo jiù xíguàn le. A: Hé xiǎojiě zhǐshì wǒ de línjū, bùshì wǒ de nǚpéngyǒu, dàjiā dōu wùhuì le. B: Nǐ duì tā hěn tǐtiē, bùdàn cháng sòng tā shàngbān, hái cháng péi tā guàngjiē, dàjiā duì nǐmen yǒu wùhuì yě shì zhèngcháng de.
examples.english: My younger brother and I are twins; many people think I am him, and I've long been used to this kind of misunderstanding. A: Miss He is just my neighbor, not my girlfriend; everyone has misunderstood. B: You are very considerate to her; not only do you often take her to work, but you also often accompany her shopping. It's normal for everyone to have a misunderstanding about you two.

examples.chinese: 因為工作太忙的關係，夏小姐已經有一段時間沒上街購物了。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò tài máng de guānxì, Xià xiǎojiě yǐjīng yǒu yī duàn shíjiān méi shàngjiē gòuwù le.
examples.english: Because she is too busy with work, Miss Xia has not gone out shopping for some time.

examples.chinese: 這次颱風雨大風又強，大街上不少店家都關店休息。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì táifēng yǔ dà fēng yòu qiáng, dàjiē shang bùshǎo diànjiā dōu guān diàn xiūxi.
examples.english: This typhoon brought heavy rain and strong winds; on the main street, many shops closed to rest.

examples.chinese: 在熱鬧的都市裡，常見一些人在街頭表演。
examples.pinyin: Zài rènao de dūshì lǐ, cháng jiàn yīxiē rén zài jiētóu biǎoyǎn.
examples.english: In bustling cities, you often see some people performing in the street.

examples.chinese: 這條街道旁有各式各樣的商店與餐廳，假日時相當熱鬧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo jiēdào páng yǒu gèshìgèyàng de shāngdiàn yǔ cāntīng, jiàrì shí xiāngdāng rènao.
examples.english: Along this street there are all kinds of shops and restaurants; on holidays it is quite bustling.

examples.chinese: 我逛街時經過了一排小吃攤，就買幾樣回來當作宵夜。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ guàngjiē shí jīngguò le yì pái xiǎochītān, jiù mǎi jǐ yàng huílái dàngzuò xiāoyè.
examples.english: When I was shopping, I passed a row of food stalls and bought a few items to bring back as a late-night snack.

examples.chinese: 金小姐常利用假日，牽著家中那隻活潑的小黑狗到街上逛逛。
examples.pinyin: Jīn xiǎojiě cháng lìyòng jiàrì, qiānzhe jiā zhōng nà zhī huópō de xiǎo hēigǒu dào jiē shàng guàngguang.
examples.english: Miss Jin often uses her holidays to hold the leash of that lively little black dog at home and take it for a stroll on the streets.

examples.chinese: 這位郵差的聲音很大，每次他來送信，整條街全都聽見了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi yóuchāi de shēngyīn hěn dà, měi cì tā lái sòng xìn, zhěng tiáo jiē quán dōu tīngjiàn le.
examples.english: This postman's voice is very loud; every time he comes to deliver mail, the whole street hears it.

items.wordHook: a 彳(step) toward the 圭(jade tablet) stalls, then a 亍(small step) → the bustling 街(street).

examples.chinese: 好多人來這家店買蛋糕，他們的蛋糕一定很好吃吧？
examples.pinyin: Hǎo duō rén lái zhè jiā diàn mǎi dàngāo, tāmen de dàngāo yīdìng hěn hǎochī ba?
examples.english: Many people come to this shop to buy cakes; their cakes must be very delicious, right?

examples.chinese: 妳看，這條黃色的褲子不錯吧？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kàn, zhè tiáo huángsè de kùzi búcuò ba?
examples.english: Look! This pair of yellow pants is nice, isn’t it?

examples.chinese: 沒關係，我們可以下個週末再來看。對了，妳要買鞋子吧？
examples.pinyin: Méiguānxi, wǒmen kěyǐ xià ge zhōumò zài lái kàn. Duìle, nǐ yào mǎi xiézi ba?
examples.english: It’s okay; we can come again next weekend. By the way, you want to buy shoes, don’t you?

examples.chinese: 鞋子都在一樓，我們到樓下去吧！九點了，百貨公司快要關了。
examples.pinyin: Xiézi dōu zài yì lóu, wǒmen dào lóuxià qù ba! Jiǔ diǎn le, bǎihuògōngsī kuàiyào guān le.
examples.english: All the shoes are on the first floor. Let’s go downstairs. It’s 9:00; the department store is closing soon.

examples.chinese: 這本雜誌有點兒舊，我幫你買一本新的吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn zázhì yǒudiǎnr jiù, wǒ bāng nǐ mǎi yī běn xīn de ba.
examples.english: This magazine is a bit old; let me help you buy a new one.

examples.chinese: 那家餐廳很近，我們走路去吧！
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā cāntīng hěn jìn, wǒmen zǒulù qù ba!
examples.english: That restaurant is very close; let's walk there!

examples.chinese: 今天下午學校有籃球比賽，我們去看吧！
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān xiàwǔ xuéxiào yǒu lánqiú bǐsài, wǒmen qù kàn ba!
examples.english: There is a basketball game at school this afternoon. Let’s go watch it!

examples.chinese: 今天天氣不錯，我們去海邊曬太陽吧。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì búcuò, wǒmen qù hǎibiān shài tàiyáng ba.
examples.english: The weather is nice today. Let’s go to the beach to get some sun!

examples.chinese: 這枝筆太貴了，你買便宜的吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī bǐ tài guì le, nǐ mǎi piányi de ba.
examples.english: This pen is too expensive, you had better buy a cheaper one.

examples.chinese: 這支筆太貴了，你買便宜的吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī bǐ tài guì le, nǐ mǎi piányi de ba.
examples.english: This pen is too expensive; buy a cheap one (suggestion).

examples.chinese: 好，我們明天坐捷運去吧。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒmen míngtiān zuò jiéyùn qù ba.
examples.english: Ok, let’s take the MRT to get there tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 啊！上課了！我們先上課吧。
examples.pinyin: A! Shàngkè le! Wǒmen xiān shàngkè ba.
examples.english: Ah! The class has started! Let’s go to class now.

examples.chinese: 打網球怎麼樣？中明說妳的網球打得很好，我們一起去打吧。
examples.pinyin: Dǎ wǎngqiú zěnmeyàng? Zhōngmíng shuō nǐ de wǎngqiú dǎ de hěn hǎo, wǒmen yìqǐ qù dǎ ba.
examples.english: How about playing tennis? Zhongming said you play it well. Let’s go play it together.

examples.chinese: 我很忙，現在要去廚房做飯，你再去房間找吧。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn máng, xiànzài yào qù chúfáng zuòfàn, nǐ zài qù fángjiān zhǎo ba.
examples.english: I am very busy and I am going to the kitchen to cook now. You go check your room again.

examples.chinese: 我們這個星期六下午兩點半去吧。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zhè ge xīngqí liù xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn bàn qù ba.
examples.english: Let’s go this Saturday at 2:30 p.m.

examples.chinese: 你不想坐公車，那(麼)我們坐計程車吧。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bù xiǎng zuò gōngchē, nà(me) wǒmen zuò jìchéngchē ba.
examples.english: You don't want to take the bus; then let's take a taxi.

examples.chinese: 如果他不能接電話，你就留言吧！
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ tā bù néng jiē diànhuà, nǐ jiù liúyán ba!
examples.english: If he can't answer the phone, then leave a message!

examples.chinese: A:我們要點幾盤菜？ B:今天是你的生日，我們多點幾盤吧。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒmen yào diǎn jǐ pán cài? B: Jīntiān shì nǐ de shēngrì, wǒmen duō diǎn jǐ pán ba.
examples.english: A: How many dishes shall we order? B: Today is your birthday; let's order a few more dishes.

examples.chinese: 外面很冷，請進來吧！
examples.pinyin: Wàimiàn hěn lěng, qǐng jìnlái ba!
examples.english: It's very cold outside; please come in!

examples.chinese: 上次我們吃牛肉麵，這次也吃牛肉麵，下次吃別的吧。
examples.pinyin: Shàng cì wǒmen chī niúròumiàn, zhè cì yě chī niúròumiàn, xià cì chī bié de ba.
examples.english: Last time we ate beef noodles, this time we're also eating beef noodles; next time let's eat something else.

examples.chinese: 晚上的風很舒服，我們一起出去走走吧。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnshang de fēng hěn shūfu, wǒmen yìqǐ chūqù zǒuzou ba.
examples.english: The evening wind is very comfortable; let's go out for a walk together.

examples.chinese: 小王手裡提著那麼多東西，好像很重，我們過去幫他提一些吧！
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Wáng shǒu lǐ tízhe nàme duō dōngxi, hǎoxiàng hěn zhòng, wǒmen guòqù bāng tā tí yīxiē ba!
examples.english: Xiao Wang is carrying so many things in his hands; they look heavy. Let's go over and help him carry some!

examples.chinese: A:小李怎麼還不來？等了半天， 我快餓死了。 B:算了，我們先吃吧，要不然菜涼了就不好吃了！
examples.pinyin: A: Xiǎo Lǐ zěnme hái bù lái? Děng le bàntiān, wǒ kuài è sǐ le. B: Suàn le, wǒmen xiān chī ba, yàobùrán cài liáng le jiù bù hǎochī le!
examples.english: A: Why isn't Xiao Li here yet? I've been waiting forever, I'm starving to death. B: Forget about it, let's eat first, otherwise the food will get cold and won't taste good!

examples.chinese: 你先別急著買，貨比三家不吃虧，多看幾家再決定吧！
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān bié jízhe mǎi, huò bǐ sān jiā bù chīkuī, duō kàn jǐ jiā zài juédìng ba!
examples.english: Don't rush to buy yet; shopping around at three stores won't hurt—look at a few more stores before deciding!

examples.chinese: A:這個玩具雖然可愛，但是不適合送給剛滿月的孩子，我們還是送紅包吧！ B:也好。送紅包也不錯。
examples.pinyin: A: Zhège wánjù suīrán kě'ài, dànshì bù shìhé sòng gěi gāng mǎn yuè de háizi, wǒmen háishì sòng hóngbāo ba! B: Yě hǎo. Sòng hóngbāo yě bùcuò.
examples.english: A: Although this toy is cute, it's not suitable to give to a child who has just turned one month old; we might as well give a red envelope! B: That's fine. Giving a red envelope is also good.

examples.chinese: 前面發生了交通意外，為了避免被困在路上，我們還是走別條路吧。
examples.pinyin: Qiánmiàn fāshēng le jiāotōng yìwài, wèile bìmiǎn bèi kùn zài lùshàng, wǒmen háishì zǒu bié tiáo lù ba.
examples.english: There was a traffic accident ahead; to avoid being stuck on the road, we should take another route.

examples.chinese: 既然你不想衝浪，那就坐在海灘上曬曬太陽吧！
examples.pinyin: Jìrán nǐ bù xiǎng chōnglàng, nà jiù zuò zài hǎitān shàng shài shài tàiyáng ba!
examples.english: Since you don't want to surf, then just sit on the beach and soak up some sun!

examples.chinese: 我們樂團今晚的表演很成功，一起放煙火來慶祝吧！
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yuètuán jīnwǎn de biǎoyǎn hěn chénggōng, yīqǐ fàng yānhuǒ lái qìngzhù ba!
examples.english: Our band's performance tonight was very successful; let's set off fireworks together to celebrate!

examples.chinese: A:怎麼回事？外面怎麼這麼吵？ B:鄰居在修理屋頂，快修理好了，你忍耐一下吧。
examples.pinyin: A: Zěnme huí shì? Wàimiàn zěnme zhème chǎo? B: Línjū zài xiūlǐ wūdǐng, kuài xiūlǐ hǎo le, nǐ rěnnài yīxià ba.
examples.english: A: What's the matter? Why is it so noisy outside? B: The neighbor is repairing the roof; it will be fixed soon, so please put up with it for a bit.

examples.chinese: 電視上正在播出跨年演唱會，節目非常吸引人，你快來看吧。
examples.pinyin: Diànshì shàng zhèngzài bōchū kuànián yǎnchànghuì, jiémù fēicháng xīyǐn rén, nǐ kuài lái kàn ba.
examples.english: The TV is broadcasting the New Year's Eve concert right now; the program is very attractive, so come watch it quickly.

examples.chinese: 這個手錶你已經戴了快二十年了吧？他對你有甚麼特殊的意義呢？
examples.pinyin: Zhège shǒubiǎo nǐ yǐjīng dài le kuài èrshí nián le ba? Tā duì nǐ yǒu shénme tèshū de yìyì ne?
examples.english: You have already worn this watch for almost twenty years, right? Does it have any special meaning to you?

examples.chinese: 這個銷售計畫很好，不過得先解決相關費用和推銷人員等現實問題。A:如果現在有一千萬從天上掉下來，那該多好啊！ B:你別再做夢了，趕快回到現實吧！
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiāoshòu jìhuà hěn hǎo, bùguò děi xiān jiějué xiāngguān fèiyòng hé tuīxiāo rényuán děng xiànshí wèntí. A: Rúguǒ xiànzài yǒu yīqiān wàn cóng tiānshàng diào xiàlái, nà gāi duō hǎo a! B: Nǐ bié zài zuòmèng le, gǎnkuài huídào xiànshí ba!
examples.english: This sales plan is good, but we must first solve realistic problems such as related costs and sales personnel. A: If ten million were to fall from the sky right now, how great that would be! B: Stop dreaming and quickly return to reality!

examples.chinese: 客人看了那件洋裝一眼就走了，應該不喜歡吧。
examples.pinyin: Kèrén kàn le nà jiàn yángzhuāng yì yǎn jiù zǒu le, yīnggāi bù xǐhuān ba.
examples.english: The customer took one glance at that dress and then left; she probably doesn't like it.

examples.chinese: A:犯錯的人都可以請求原諒嗎？ B:得看他犯的是什麼錯，要是小小的錯，就該原諒吧。
examples.pinyin: A: Fàncuò de rén dōu kěyǐ qǐngqiú yuánliàng ma? B: Děi kàn tā fàn de shì shénme cuò, yàoshi xiǎoxiǎo de cuò, jiù gāi yuánliàng ba.
examples.english: A: Can everyone who makes a mistake ask for forgiveness? B: It depends on what mistake he made; if it's a small mistake, then he should be forgiven.

examples.chinese: A:你說老闆下個月要提高每個人的薪水，沒騙我吧？ B:這個消息是從他的口中說出來的，當然是真的。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ shuō lǎobǎn xià gè yuè yào tígāo měi gè rén de xīnshuǐ, méi piàn wǒ ba? B: Zhège xiāoxi shì cóng tā de kǒu zhōng shuō chūlái de, dāngrán shì zhēn de.
examples.english: A: You said the boss is going to raise everyone's salary next month—you're not fooling me, are you? B: This news came out of his own mouth; of course it's true.

examples.chinese: A:我到底該怎麼做才能讓老闆滿意？ B:你太驕傲、個性太急， 做事也不夠仔細。總之， 先把自己的缺點改掉吧。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ dàodǐ gāi zěnme zuò cái néng ràng lǎobǎn mǎnyì? B: Nǐ tài jiāo'ào, gèxìng tài jí, zuòshì yě bù gòu zǐxì. Zǒngzhī, xiān bǎ zìjǐ de quēdiǎn gǎi diào ba.
examples.english: A: What on earth should I do to satisfy the boss? B: You are too arrogant, your personality is too impatient, and you are not careful enough in doing things. In short, first change your shortcomings.

examples.chinese: 現在他在上書法課，我們四點去吧。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài tā zài shàng shūfǎ kè, wǒmen sì diǎn qù ba.
examples.english: He is in the calligraphy class now. Let’s do it at 4 p.m.

items.wordHook: a 口(mouth) wishes with 巴(to wish) for one more song → 吧(suggestion).

examples.chinese: A:你現在要回宿舍嗎？ B:還沒，我要先去吃飯再回宿舍。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ xiànzài yào huí sùshè ma? B: Hái méi, wǒ yào xiān qù chīfàn zài huí sùshè.
examples.english: A: Are you going back to the dorm now? B: Not yet; I want to go eat first and then go back to the dorm.

examples.chinese: A:你已經決定明年去英國了嗎？ B:我還沒做決定。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ yǐjīng juédìng míngnián qù Yīngguó le ma? B: Wǒ hái méi zuò juédìng.
examples.english: A: Have you already decided to go to England next year? B: I haven't made a decision yet.

examples.chinese: 老師為什麼還沒來？大家都覺得很奇怪。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī wèishénme hái méi lái? Dàjiā dōu juéde hěn qíguài.
examples.english: Why hasn't the teacher come yet? Everyone feels it's very strange.

examples.chinese: 我還沒去過日本，今年可能有機會去。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hái méi qù guo Rìběn, jīnnián kěnéng yǒu jīhuì qù.
examples.english: I have not yet been to Japan; this year I might have a chance to go.

examples.chinese: 明天我要跟朋友去參加跨年活動，我還沒跟父母講這件事。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān wǒ yào gēn péngyǒu qù cānjiā kuànián huódòng, wǒ hái méi gēn fùmǔ jiǎng zhè jiàn shì.
examples.english: Tomorrow I'm going with friends to attend a New Year's Eve event; I still haven't talked to my parents about this.

examples.chinese: 就要開會了，可是我同事還沒把新產品的說明資料準備好，真叫人緊張。
examples.pinyin: Jiù yào kāihuì le, kěshì wǒ tóngshì hái méi bǎ xīn chǎnpǐn de shuōmíng zīliào zhǔnbèi hǎo, zhēn jiào rén jǐnzhāng.
examples.english: The meeting is about to start, but my colleague still hasn't prepared the explanatory materials for the new product, which really makes one nervous.

examples.chinese: 外面風大雨大，媽媽只好把還沒乾的衣服收進來，掛在屋內。
examples.pinyin: Wàimiàn fēng dà yǔ dà, māma zhǐhǎo bǎ hái méi gān de yīfu shōu jìnlái, guà zài wū nèi.
examples.english: Outside the wind and rain were strong, so Mom had no choice but to bring in the clothes that were not yet dry and hang them inside the house.

examples.chinese: 照顧還沒成年的孩子是父母應盡的責任，無論如何，既然生了就該養他、教導他。
examples.pinyin: Zhàogù hái méi chéngnián de háizi shì fùmǔ yīng jìn de zérèn, wúlùnrúhé, jìrán shēng le jiù gāi yǎng tā, jiàodǎo tā.
examples.english: Taking care of children who are not yet adults is a responsibility parents should fulfill; in any case, since you gave birth to them, you should raise them and educate them.

examples.chinese: 友美說她想去，我還沒決定去不去。燈會好玩嗎？
examples.pinyin: Yǒuměi shuō tā xiǎng qù, wǒ háiméi juédìng qù bú qù. Dēnghuì hǎowán ma?
examples.english: Youmei wants to see it. But I haven’t decided to go. Is the Lantern Carnival fun?

examples.chinese: 這課的課文很有意思，我很喜歡。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kè de kèwén hěn yǒu yìsi, wǒ hěn xǐhuān.
examples.english: The text of this lesson is very interesting; I like it very much.

items.wordHook: 課(lesson) + 文(language) → the language of a lesson is its 課文 'text'.

examples.chinese: 因為強烈颱風的關係，機場已經關了，等風小一點才會再開放。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi qiángliè táifēng de guānxì, jīchǎng yǐjīng guān le, děng fēng xiǎo yīdiǎn cái huì zài kāifàng.
examples.english: Because of the strong typhoon, the airport has already closed; it will open again only after the wind gets a little weaker.

examples.chinese: 那輛腳踏車對個子小的我來說太高了，腳很難跨過去。我們大學前年起已開放跨校選課，增加各校的交流機會。
examples.pinyin: Nà liàng jiǎotàchē duì gèzi xiǎo de wǒ lái shuō tài gāo le, jiǎo hěn nán kuà guòqù. Wǒmen dàxué qiánnián qǐ yǐ kāifàng kuàxiào xuǎnkè, zēngjiā gè xiào de jiāoliú jīhuì.
examples.english: That bicycle is too high for me, since I'm short, so it's hard to straddle my leg over it. Our university has offered cross-school course selection since the year before last, increasing opportunities for exchange between schools.

examples.chinese: 中國開放國內投資後，想投資人民幣的人也越來越多了。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngguó kāifàng guónèi tóuzī hòu, xiǎng tóuzī rénmínbì de rén yě yuèláiyuè duō le.
examples.english: After China opened up domestic investment, more and more people want to invest in RMB.

examples.chinese: 當你願意開放自己的心時， 你所見的世界也會更加地美妙。
examples.pinyin: Dāng nǐ yuànyì kāifàng zìjǐ de xīn shí, nǐ suǒ jiàn de shìjiè yě huì gèngjiā de měimiào.
examples.english: When you are willing to open your heart, the world you see will also become even more wonderful.

examples.chinese: 這家博物館曾因戰爭而被破壞，如今總算重新開放參觀。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā bówùguǎn céng yīn zhànzhēng ér bèi pòhuài, rújīn zǒngsuàn chóngxīn kāifàng cānguān.
examples.english: This museum was once destroyed because of war, and nowadays it has finally reopened for visits.

items.wordHook: To 開(open) a 放(release): 開放 means open.

examples.chinese: 台灣這場地震的規模很大，使許多人受輕傷、重傷。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān zhè chǎng dìzhèn de guīmó hěn dà, shǐ xǔduō rén shòu qīngshāng, zhòngshāng.
examples.english: The scale of this earthquake in Taiwan was very large, causing many people to suffer minor and serious injuries.

examples.chinese: 我話先說在前頭，要是你不照他所說的去做，等後頭出了問題，情況可就更複雜了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ huà xiān shuō zài qiántou, yàoshi nǐ bù zhào tā suǒ shuō de qù zuò, děng hòutou chū le wèntí, qíngkuàng kě jiù gèng fúzá le.
examples.english: I'll say this first (up front): if you don't do as he says, when problems arise later, the situation will become even more complicated.

examples.chinese: 孩子們好不容易才安靜，別去鬧他們，不然又要開始吵鬧了。
examples.pinyin: Háizimen hǎobùróngyì cái ānjìng, bié qù nào tāmen, bùrán yòu yào kāishǐ chǎonào le.
examples.english: The children have finally quieted down with great difficulty; don't go disturb them, or they will start making noise again.

items.wordHook: A left hand puts a seedling onto the 土(earth) → right there is where you are: 在(at).
十(ten) and 八(eight) draw a tree: 十(ten) is the trunk, 八(eight) is the branching fork → 木(wood).
Inside a 冂(frame) sit 二(two) bars → grab them to 用(use).
Gathering 總(gather) all points 而(and) presenting them in concise 言(words) as a summary 之(of) the matter: 總而言之 means in short.
英(English) + 國(country) → the country of the English, the UK.
The 飠(food) of an 官(official) welcomes travelers inside the grand 館(public building).
